ambiguity.reason: Ambiguous cases are documented separately. Multi-answer positives keep multiple expected IDs instead of forcing a single canonical target.

freshness.reason: The captured scenes have no temporal recapture or change labels, so freshness/change queries would be fabricated.

negative_absence_review.reason: Negative cases are reviewed separately to avoid fake accuracy.

ground_truth_scope: All expected fields are verified against manual captured-scene ViewJSON and generated tree nodes, with manual zone references from view overlap. This benchmark is suitable for semantic-index regression and graph-vs-flat same-input evaluation. It is not independent visual/dataset GT, does not provide 3D boxes, and has no official Replica/ScanNet provenance.
